title: Largest Combination With Bitwise AND Greater Than Zero
description: Given an array of positive integers `candidates`, evaluate the bitwise AND of any non-empty subset (combination) of `candidates`. Return the maximum size of a subset whose bitwise AND is strictly greater than `0`.
hints: A subset has bitwise AND > 0 if and only if there exists at least one bit position `b` where every chosen element has a `1`.
For each bit position `b` from 0 to 23, count how many elements of `candidates` have bit `b` set, and return the maximum count.

examples.explanation: The subset [16, 17, 62, 24] all have bit 4 (value 16) set, giving a size-4 combination with AND > 0.
Both 8 and 8 share bit 3, giving size 2.
Powers of two have disjoint set bits, so at most 1 element can be chosen.
